disclaimer: General information only, not legal or financial advice. Claiming is always free on the official site.

entries.name: CommBank Open Banking (CDR) Goodwill and Remediation Program
entries.case: Remediation following an ACCC investigation into Consumer Data Right Rules breaches
entries.eligibility: You held (or could transact on) certain CBA accounts since 1 November 2021 (e.g. trading-name accounts, joint accounts with a trust or business, CommBiz accounts, market rate loan facilities), tried to share data through the Consumer Data Right and could not because sharing was not enabled.
entries.proof_notes: Evidence that you tried to share data for an eligible account and that you suffered loss as a result.
entries.estimated_payout: $700 goodwill payment for eligible customers who complained before 21 January 2026; remediation claims for larger losses are assessed on evidence, subject to AFCA-equivalent limits.
entries.note: Mostly relevant to business, trust and joint account holders.

entries.name: Virgin Australia Notes Class Action
entries.defendant: Virgin Australia Holdings Limited, two former directors, a related entity and Virgin Australia's insurers
entries.case: Matheson Property Group Pty Ltd as trustee for the MPG Trust v Virgin Australia Holdings Limited & Ors, NSD346/2022 (Federal Court of Australia)
entries.eligibility: You bought unsecured Australian-dollar notes issued by Virgin Australia on 26 November 2019, or unsecured US-dollar notes issued on 7 November 2019.
entries.proof_notes: The online registration form sets out what is needed; we have not seen the form's contents.
entries.administrator: Corrs Chambers Westgarth (applicant's solicitors; enquiries vah.class.action@corrs.com.au)
entries.case_note: No settlement yet. Federal Court orders set 4:00pm AEDT on 21 December 2026 as the deadline to register (to share in any settlement reached before trial) or to opt out. Unregistered group members may be barred from sharing in such a settlement.

entries.name: Harvey Norman 'Product Care' Extended Warranty Class Action
entries.defendant: Harvey Norman (also Domayne and Joyce Mayne)
entries.case: Consolidated class action run by Maurice Blackburn with Echo Law
entries.eligibility: You bought a 'Product Care' extended warranty from Harvey Norman, Domayne or Joyce Mayne between 17 September 2018 and 19 September 2024.
entries.case_note: No settlement or judgment yet. The firm says group members must register to stay in the class action and be told about any Court deadline.

entries.name: Medibank Data Breach Privacy Complaint (OAIC representative complaint)
entries.case: Representative complaint to the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner (Maurice Blackburn)
entries.eligibility: Current or former Medibank, ahm or international student customers whose information was affected by the 2022 data breach (see the page for the exact criteria).
entries.proof_notes: Registration is free; no documents are listed as required to register.
entries.case_note: This is a privacy complaint, not a court settlement. The page says there is no registration deadline at this stage. A separate shareholder/customer class action (McClure v Medibank, VID64/2023) is in the Federal Court.

entries.name: Nuix Shareholder Class Action
entries.case: Consolidated Nuix shareholder class action, Supreme Court of Victoria (Shine Lawyers with Phi Finney McDonald)
entries.eligibility: You acquired an interest in Nuix (ASX:NXL) shares between 18 November 2020 and 29 June 2021 (inclusive).
entries.proof_notes: Registration form on Shine's page; shareholding details likely needed.
entries.case_note: No settlement. Mediation in June 2025 failed; Shine says registrations have reopened and an initial trial was listed to start 27 July 2026. Registering is free and does not guarantee a payment.

entries.name: Allianz Car Dealer Add-On Insurance Class Action Settlement
entries.case: Fuller & Anor v Allianz Australia Insurance Ltd & Anor (Supreme Court of Victoria)
entries.eligibility: Registered group members who were sent an Estimated Distribution Notice.
entries.proof_notes: The deadline to submit bank details has passed.
entries.case_note: $170 million settlement. Maurice Blackburn now expects payments to start in the first quarter of 2027. Nothing new can be lodged.

entries.name: QSuper Insurance Premiums Class Action Settlement
entries.case: Jessica Amy Challenor v QSuper Board, VID691/2021 (Federal Court of Australia)
entries.eligibility: Only members who registered by the Court deadline and were assessed eligible.
entries.administrator: Shine Lawyers (Settlement Administrator); Australian Retirement Trust (Settlement Distributor)
entries.case_note: Final orders 18 June 2026; in administration since August 2026. Timing of payments not yet confirmed.

entries.name: Qantas Flight Credits Class Action Settlement
entries.case: Marianne Haverkort v Qantas Airways Limited, VID650/2023 (Federal Court of Australia)
entries.eligibility: Customers who held tickets for Qantas flights cancelled between 2020 and 2022 and registered by 4pm AEST on 2 October 2026.
entries.case_note: $105 million proposed settlement. Registration closed 2 October 2026. The Court heard the approval application on 13 October 2026; press reports say the judge wanted more information before approving (Echo Law's page still describes the hearing prospectively). Not yet approved.

entries.name: AMP Super Fees Class Action Settlement
entries.defendant: AMP superannuation trustees and AMP Group entities
entries.case: Alford & Anor v AMP Superannuation Limited & Ors, VID572/2019 (Federal Court of Australia)
entries.eligibility: You held certain AMP superannuation accounts between 1 July 2008 and 15 May 2020.
entries.proof_notes: Payments are based on a member list from AMP; members on that list do not need to take any active steps.
entries.case_note: $120 million settlement approved by the Federal Court on 27 July 2026. Payment timing not stated on the page we checked.

entries.name: MLC MySuper (formerly NAB MySuper) Class Action Settlement
entries.defendant: NULIS Nominees (Australia) Limited and related MLC/NAB entities
entries.eligibility: Group members as defined in the MLC MySuper class action (see the official page and Settlement Distribution Scheme).
entries.proof_notes: Distributed by the MLC Super Fund trustee (NULIS) under the Court-approved scheme.
entries.case_note: Settlement approved 12 May 2025 ($64.25m). Maurice Blackburn says settlement payments began in late 2025 and continue through 2026 via the MLC Super Fund trustee (automatic; no registration).
